summary: 71-year-old man fishing on the Taylor River did not return home; reported missing Tuesday afternoon. WSC SAR dog team and Crested Butte SAR searched Tuesday evening, resumed Wednesday morning, and found his body near Lodgepole Campground around 11 a.m.
responding_agency: Western State College SAR, Crested Butte SAR
notes: Name withheld at press time; cause undetermined. Body found Wed 2011-06-29; incident date pinned to report day Tue 2011-06-28. CBN 2011-07 'busy summer' feature mentions this mission (searched for a man missing in the Taylor River).
